question: Under the PC-PNDT Act, Form F must be filled in for every pregnant woman who undergoes an ultrasound examination, recording the indication and confirming sex was not communicated.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. Form F is the mandatory record for every prenatal ultrasound under PC-PNDT — failure to complete it is itself an offence, even if no sex determination was attempted.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Form F is mandatory for every obstetric ultrasound under the PC-PNDT Act. It records the patient's details, indication, and a declaration that sex was not disclosed. Failure to maintain Form F is an offence.
